headline: OpenAI, Google and Microsoft announce support for a shared robots.txt AI-training preference
summary: On 30 October 2026, OpenAI and Google announced plans to honor a shared robots.txt signal for website operators to express preferences about using content for generative-AI training. Microsoft also announced support and says its shared training preference will begin taking effect as it crawls from 1 February 2027. The mechanism is described in an individual IETF Internet-Draft, which is not endorsed by IETF and has no formal standing in its standards process. No live implementation, cross-provider conformance, or change in content collection or training data has been observed.
